summary: Per-frame vehicle brake/tire thermal integration and wear simulation, called by the vehicle physics integration step. Converts brake force, slip, and angular velocity into per-wheel heat, integrates temperatures with ambient Kelvin offsets (flt_8AFEF0/flt_8AFEF4 + 273.16), clamps the integrated temperature into a safe range, and computes a wear/degradation term from torque and slip ratio. On extreme slip it triggers a blowout-style transition that scales down the brake/tire force fields and resets degradation, and it dispatches pit-state or AI-phase transitions (AISessionPhaseCounter / PitStateSlotActivation) based on slip classification.
